title: Label the pictures
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Cleanliness, shapes and numbers to 20
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 8 (Pupil PDF worksheet: label the pictures)
intro: Lesson 8: Cleanliness: washing and wudu words. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Cleanliness and wudu
points: Allah loves those who keep clean

blocks.title: Sort into: Something we use / Something we do or keep
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Something we use, Something we do or keep.
blocks.answer: Something we use: مَاء; صَابُون; مِنْشَفَة. Something we do or keep: وُضُوء; نَظَافَة

blocks.text: Draw each thing in a box (no faces). Write its Arabic name under it, copying the harakat from the word bank.

questions.q: Say and show: hold up soap and say its name.
Label five pictures on the pupil PDF (tap, soap, towel, wudu area, clean hands) with the Arabic words, copying the harakat.
Extend: read 'هٰذَا مَاءٌ' and say what it means.
Stretch: write 'This is a towel' in Arabic.
Think again: name the three things you use to keep clean in Arabic.
